name: Iridic-Tempest
description: Cloud-architecture stacks to the horizon in every direction, ammonia cirrus above, sulfurous murk below. Great storm eyes stare up out of the depths, unhurried and permanent.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
For traders, helium-3 and fusion fuel alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
